purpose: Original offline method primers and research source locators; no empirical observations, confidential data, licensed textbooks or imported upstream code.

title.zh-Hans: 微观经济学与市场机制
title.ja: ミクロ経済学と市場メカニズム

summary.en: Specify actors, preferences, technologies, constraints, information and equilibrium concept before claiming an outcome.
summary.zh-Hans: 先明确行为主体、偏好、技术、约束、信息和均衡概念，再讨论模型结果。
summary.ko: 결과를 주장하기 전에 경제주체·선호·기술·제약·정보·균형 개념을 명시합니다。
summary.ja: 結果を主張する前に、主体・選好・技術・制約・情報・均衡概念を明示します。

cards.method_brief_en: Distinguish behavioral premises from measurements; welfare and efficiency need explicit definitions, institutions and distributional weights.

title.ja: マクロ経済の動学と政策

summary.en: Dynamic macro models require stated identities, shocks, policy rules, initial/steady states and time resolution.
summary.zh-Hans: 动态宏观模型需要明确恒等式、冲击、政策规则、初始或稳态以及时间分辨率。
summary.ko: 동태 거시 모형에는 항등식·충격·정책준칙·초깃값 또는 정상상태·시간 해상도가 필요합니다.
summary.ja: 動学マクロモデルには恒等式、ショック、政策ルール、初期・定常状態、時間粒度が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: A .mod file or DSGE label does not prove solution existence, calibration validity, convergence or policy identification. Solvers may fail.

title.zh-Hans: 异质性家庭与生命周期
title.ja: 異質的家計とライフサイクル

summary.en: Consumption, saving and heterogeneous-agent results depend on budgets, income risk, preferences and aggregation.
summary.zh-Hans: 消费、储蓄与异质性主体的结果取决于预算、收入风险、偏好与加总方式。
summary.ko: 소비·저축·이질적 주체 결과는 예산·소득위험·선호·집계 방식에 좌우됩니다.
summary.ja: 消費・貯蓄・異質的主体の結果は予算、所得リスク、選好、集計方法に依存します。

cards.method_brief_en: Specify borrowing limits, horizons, stochastic processes, estimation targets, grids and interpolation diagnostics; distinguish representative agent assumptions.

title.zh-Hans: 马尔可夫过程与动态规划
title.ja: マルコフ過程と動的計画法

summary.en: State transitions and optimal policies require transition probabilities, objectives and clear time semantics.
summary.zh-Hans: 状态转移与最优策略需要转移概率、目标函数和明确的时间语义。
summary.ko: 상태전이와 최적 정책에는 전이확률·목적함수·명확한 시간 의미가 필요합니다.
summary.ja: 状態遷移と最適政策には遷移確率、目的関数、明確な時間の意味が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: Check stochastic matrices, state space, discounting, terminal conditions, convergence and stationarity assumptions.

title.zh-Hans: 计量经济学与统计推断
title.ja: 計量経済学と統計的推論

summary.en: An estimate needs its dataset vintage, estimand, sampling process, uncertainty and model diagnostics.
summary.zh-Hans: 估计结果须说明数据版本、目标参数、抽样机制、不确定性与模型诊断。
summary.ko: 추정 결과에는 데이터 버전·추정대상·표본추출 과정·불확실성·모형 진단이 필요합니다.
summary.ja: 推定結果にはデータ版、推定対象、標本過程、不確実性、モデル診断が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: Observational associations are not causal effects without justified identification. Distinguish estimation, prediction, diagnostics and sensitivity.

title.ja: ゲーム理論と戦略的行動

summary.en: Define players, actions, information, payoffs, timing and equilibrium concept; AI-agent behavior is not representative by default.
summary.zh-Hans: 定义参与者、行动、信息、收益、时序与均衡概念；AI主体行为不能默认代表真实人群。
summary.ko: 참가자·행동·정보·보수·시점·균형 개념을 명시하고 AI 행동을 곧 현실의 대표값으로 취급하지 않습니다.
summary.ja: プレイヤー、行動、情報、利得、時系列、均衡概念を明記し、AI行動を現実の代表値と見なしません。

cards.method_brief_en: Distinguish rule-based subjects from stochastic or LLM subjects. Report repeated-run variability and provider versions.

title.zh-Hans: 基于主体的建模与调度
title.ja: エージェントベースモデルとスケジューリング

summary.en: Agent models require declared state, interaction topology, schedules, random seeds, observations and calibration boundaries.
summary.zh-Hans: 主体模型需要声明状态、交互拓扑、调度、随机种子、观测与校准范围。
summary.ko: 행위자 모형에는 상태·상호작용 구조·실행 순서·난수 시드·관측·보정 범위가 필요합니다.
summary.ja: エージェントモデルには状態、相互作用、スケジュール、乱数シード、観測、校正範囲が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: Synchronous and asynchronous updates can yield different results. A model demonstration is not historical validation.

title.ja: ネットワーク・拡散・情報

summary.en: Network effects require actual edge data or labeled synthetic topology, diffusion rules and measured event criteria.
summary.zh-Hans: 网络效应需要真实边数据或标注为合成的拓扑、扩散规则与可测量的事件准则。
summary.ko: 네트워크 효과에는 실제 연결 데이터 또는 합성이라고 표시된 구조·확산 규칙·측정 가능한 사건 기준이 필요합니다.
summary.ja: ネットワーク効果には実際の結合データ又は合成と示した構造、拡散則、測定可能な事象基準が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: Report sampling, missing ties, assortativity/endogeneity, exposure and time steps; do not infer causal contagion from correlation.

summary.en: Population projections depend on baseline counts, births, deaths, migration, cohorts and time granularity.
summary.zh-Hans: 人口预测取决于基期人数、生育、死亡、迁移、队列与时间粒度。
summary.ko: 인구 예측은 기준 인구·출생·사망·이주·코호트·시간 단위에 좌우됩니다.
summary.ja: 人口予測は基準人口、出生、死亡、移動、コホート、時間粒度に依存します。

cards.method_brief_en: Distinguish census observations, projections, administrative revisions and synthetic populations; document denominator changes.

summary.en: State the causal estimand and identification assumptions; sensitivity and falsification checks are essential.
summary.zh-Hans: 明确因果目标参数和识别假设；敏感性与证伪检验至关重要。
summary.ko: 인과 추정 대상과 식별 가정을 명시하고 민감도·반증 검사를 수행해야 합니다.
summary.ja: 因果推定対象と識別仮定を明示し、感度・反証検査を行う必要があります。

cards.method_brief_en: Counterfactual simulations are not randomized experiments. Explicitly separate normative comparisons, structural counterfactuals and empirically identified effects.

summary.en: Policies, institutions and organizational incentives must be represented as explicit, challengeable model rules.
summary.zh-Hans: 政策、制度与组织激励须表现为可检查、可质疑的明确模型规则。
summary.ko: 정책·제도·조직 유인은 검토와 반증이 가능한 명시적 모형 규칙으로 표현합니다.
summary.ja: 政策、制度、組織の誘因は検証・反証可能な明示的モデル規則として表現します。

cards.method_brief_en: Specify institutional scope, authority, compliance, behavioral response and distribution of consequences; avoid advocacy based on model output.

summary.en: Spatial and historical studies need units, spatial boundaries, observation dates, release vintages and map provenance.
summary.zh-Hans: 空间与历史研究需要单位、空间边界、观测日期、发布版本及地图来源。
summary.ko: 공간·역사 연구에는 단위·공간 경계·관측일·자료 공개 버전·지도 출처가 필요합니다.
summary.ja: 空間・歴史研究には単位、空間境界、観測日、公開版、地図の出典が必要です。

cards.method_brief_en: Historical backtesting with contemporary data or model knowledge can leak the future. Publication dates are different from observation dates.

title.ja: 研究の出典追跡と再現性

summary.en: Keep sources, assumptions, engine/code versions, output cells, independent reruns and limitations separate.
summary.zh-Hans: 将来源、假设、引擎与代码版本、输出单元、独立复算和局限性分开记录。
summary.ko: 자료 출처·가정·엔진/코드 버전·출력 셀·독립 재실행·한계를 분리해 기록합니다.
summary.ja: 出典、仮定、エンジン/コード版、出力セル、独立再実行、限界を区別して記録します。

cards.method_brief_en: A hash detects matching content; it does not establish author identity, run authenticity or a study's empirical validity. Cite exact run/cell/source graph edges.

title.zh-Hans: 数值精度、不确定性与失败
title.ja: 数値精度・不確実性・失敗

summary.en: Convergence, numerical error, stochastic uncertainty and structural uncertainty are distinct research questions.
summary.zh-Hans: 收敛性、数值误差、随机不确定性和结构不确定性是不同问题。
summary.ko: 수렴·수치 오차·확률적 불확실성·구조적 불확실성은 서로 다른 문제입니다.
summary.ja: 収束、数値誤差、確率的不確実性、構造的不確実性は別の問題です。

cards.method_brief_en: Do not promote Decimal flags or deterministic reproducibility to accuracy guarantees; always report solver tolerances and failures when supported.

title.ja: LLM主体と実際の人間集団

summary.en: An LLM participant is a versioned experimental policy, not automatically a representative human subject.
summary.zh-Hans: LLM参与者是一种带版本的实验策略，不能自动当作代表性人类受试者。
summary.ko: LLM 참가자는 버전이 있는 실험 정책이지 대표성 있는 인간 표본이 아닙니다.
summary.ja: LLM参加者は版管理された実験方策であり、代表的な人間標本ではありません。

cards.method_brief_en: Record prompt, model version, sampling configuration, tool visibility, seed if meaningful, cost, privacy and runs. LLM hallucinations must not become state transitions without typed validation.

title.zh-Hans: 四语种科研与数据完整性
title.ja: 四言語の研究・データ整合性

summary.en: English, simplified Chinese, Korean and Japanese labels may differ, while equations, values, provenance and time semantics must not.
summary.zh-Hans: 英文、简体中文、韩文与日文标签可以不同，但方程、数值、溯源与时间语义不得变化。
summary.ko: 영어·중국어 간체·한국어·일본어 표기는 달라도 방정식·숫자·출처·시간 의미는 바뀌면 안 됩니다.
summary.ja: 英語・簡体字中国語・韓国語・日本語の表記は異なっても、方程式、数値、出典、時間の意味は変えません。

cards.method_brief_en: Country-specific compliance and export-law claims need counsel review, and CJK PDF quality needs actual font/render testing.

source_portal_index.label: US BEA / BLS / Federal Reserve data portals
National Bureau of Statistics of China / PBOC

limits: All items are review aids, not cited empirical data or legal compliance evidence.
All source portal links are pointers only; network validation or licensing and dataset snapshots are not bundled.
Technical methods need actual researcher-selected data, estimands and executable verified engines.
Mixed-language scientific PDF rendering, human translation review and full specialized curriculum coverage are not validated.
